title.en: Attractive styling and creative grooming options

text.en: Pet owners report pleasing grooming results, highlighting tidy body cuts, creative fur colouring, and effective flea wash treatments. While one reviewer noted that a specific facial cut differed from requested reference photos, most clients praise the salon's standard styling.

Reviewers praise salon owner Phil, groomer Jackie, and staff member Gene for their pleasant demeanor and attentive customer service. Long-time patrons highlight warm welcomes and describe the salon team as personable professionals who build lasting trust with visiting pets.

title.en: Attentive care for dogs and cats

text.en: Clients appreciate that the groomers handle both canines and felines, noting gentle treatments for long-haired cats suffering from fleas. Owners of delicate breeds feel confident that their companion animals are treated with care and remain in safe, experienced hands.

q.en: Does Spot's Spot Pet Grooming groom cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers confirm that the salon accepts cats, providing full baths, shaving, and flea treatment baths.

q.en: Are custom fur colouring services available?

a.en: Yes, clients mention having their dogs styled with creative fur colours with consistent, vibrant results.
The salon primarily schedules appointments in advance, and immediate same-day walk-in availability can be limited.

q.en: How are pets housed while waiting between grooming stages?

a.en: Clients note that dogs may be kept in individual resting crates while waiting before and after their styling sessions.
